citation.title: Prolonged plasma glucose elevation on oral glucose tolerance test in young healthy Japanese individuals

population.description: 575 young Japanese university-hospital volunteers (medical candidates at Gunma University Hospital, 359 male, 216 female) classed as normal glucose tolerance after a 75 g OGTT (of 595 examined, 19 IGT and 1 IFG removed; no diabetes, no medication); the abstract gives aged 22-29 years and the methods exclude those over 30 (enrolment limits, not an observed range, so min and max are null); age and BMI as printed in Table 1, mean +/- SD (the text gives mean BMI 21.2).

protocols.name: fasting
protocols.description: Fasting plasma glucose of all 575 NGT subjects, drawn as the 0 min sample of the OGTT after a 10-hour fast; entered as a 30 min fasted run-in from 08:00 ending at the sample (clock hour and run-in length assumed)

findings.description: Fasting plasma glucose, all 575 NGT subjects (whole cohort, Table 1; not a curve-shape group)

location.where: Table 1, row 'FPG' (footnote: data presented as mean ± SD)

left_out.what: glucose and insulin at 0, 30, 60, 120 min, AUCg, AUCi, and indices, printed only by the four curve-shape groups I-IV (Table 2); no whole-cohort means printed, and pooling groups by n is not allowed
fasting plasma insulin of all 575 subjects, printed 'IU/L' (Table 1); read as printed that is 1000 times the group values Table 2 prints in uU/mL, so the unit is implausible and not corrected
HbA1c, whole cohort (Table 1) and by group (Table 2)
glycoalbumin, whole cohort (Table 1) and by group (Table 2)
HOMA-IR, HOMA-beta, Matsuda, insulinogenic and disposition indices, AUCi/AUCg (Table 2, by group)
